scenes.title: Meadow
scenes.initial_prompt: A sunny meadow of tall green grass with a single wooden fence post in the middle, a red wildflower beside it, and a line of trees on the horizon under a blue sky.

prompts.prompt: A gust of wind blows a straw hat across the meadow and it catches on top of the fence post.
The tall grass sways in the breeze.

scenes.title: Savanna
scenes.initial_prompt: Three African elephants stand under a wide acacia tree on a dry golden savanna; a muddy waterhole lies in the foreground under a pale blue sky.

prompts.prompt: The largest elephant raises its trunk high and trumpets, then lowers its trunk again.
A zebra walks in and stops beside the waterhole.
The zebra trots away out of view.

scenes.title: London street
scenes.initial_prompt: A quiet London street at night: a red double-decker bus is parked beside a red telephone box, wet cobblestones reflect the yellow streetlights, and terraced houses line the road.

prompts.prompt: Thick fog rolls down the street.
The light inside the red telephone box switches on.
The streetlights shimmer on the wet cobblestones.

scenes.title: Igloo
scenes.initial_prompt: An igloo on the snow under a clear daytime sky, with a wide flat snowfield around it.

prompts.prompt: A polar bear walks in and stops beside the igloo.
Night falls and green northern lights appear in the sky.
A red flag on a pole is planted in the snow next to the igloo.

scenes.title: Kitchen
scenes.initial_prompt: A bright kitchen: a silver kettle sits on the stove, a wooden bowl of oranges on the counter, and a window with open white blinds above the sink.

prompts.prompt: The kettle starts to boil and white steam pours from its spout.
A grey tabby cat jumps up onto the counter and sits beside the bowl of oranges.
The white blinds come down and cover the window.
The grey cat jumps down from the counter and leaves the kitchen.

scenes.title: Park bench
scenes.initial_prompt: A park path with an empty wooden bench under a leafy tree, on a sunny day.

prompts.prompt: A girl in a pink dress sits down on the bench.
Nothing else changes.
If a man is sitting on the bench, a black briefcase is put next to him; if a girl is sitting there, a big teddy bear is put next to her.
Nothing else happens.

scenes.title: Art studio
scenes.initial_prompt: An art studio in daylight: a large blank white canvas on an easel, a wooden stool, and a table with paint pots.

prompts.prompt: The white canvas becomes covered with a colourful painting of flowers.
A tabby cat jumps onto the wooden stool and sits.
Evening falls and the room is lit by a warm lamp.
Nothing else changes.

scenes.title: Attic
scenes.initial_prompt: A dim attic in daytime: a closed wooden trunk on the floorboards, a small round window, and old boxes in the corner.

prompts.prompt: The lid of the wooden trunk creaks open.
Night falls and moonlight shines through the round window.
A barn owl flies in and perches on the edge of the trunk.
The owl turns its head around, then looks forward again.

scenes.title: Library
scenes.initial_prompt: A quiet library: tall wooden bookshelves and a reading table with an open red book and a glowing green desk lamp.

prompts.prompt: The red book snaps shut.
A black cat jumps onto the reading table and curls up next to the book.
The black cat stretches its front legs and yawns, then curls up again.

scenes.title: Aquarium
scenes.initial_prompt: A home aquarium lit with white light: clear water, green plants, a closed treasure chest on the gravel, and one orange goldfish.

prompts.prompt: The lid of the treasure chest opens and bubbles stream out.
A bright blue fish swims in and stays near the plants.
The aquarium light changes to a deep blue night light.
The orange goldfish swims a quick circle and returns to where it was.

scenes.title: Garden shed
scenes.initial_prompt: A garden in daylight: a wooden shed with its door closed, a wheelbarrow full of soil standing upright, and a bed of red tulips.

prompts.prompt: The shed door swings open.
The wheelbarrow tips over and soil spills onto the path.
A robin lands on the handle of the wheelbarrow.
The sun sets and the garden glows orange.

scenes.title: Beach terrace
scenes.initial_prompt: A fresh green coconut with a pink straw stands on a wooden table on a beach terrace; a white ceramic bowl of lime wedges sits beside it, and palm trees and the sea are in the background under a bright sky.

prompts.prompt: The sun sets and the sky turns deep orange.
A gust of wind blows the pink straw out of the coconut and off the table.
A small green parrot flies down and perches on the rim of the white bowl.
Palm fronds sway gently in the background.

scenes.title: Backyard
scenes.initial_prompt: A green backyard lawn with a wooden fence, and a golden retriever lying in the shade of a tree.

prompts.prompt: Whenever a ball lands on the lawn, the dog runs over to it.
A red ball bounces onto the middle of the lawn.
A small boy walks onto the lawn.

scenes.title: Living room
scenes.initial_prompt: A living room in the afternoon: a television that is switched off, a grey sofa, a glowing floor lamp, a striped rug, and a large window.

prompts.prompt: The television turns on and shows a bright blue screen.
The floor lamp switches off.
A golden retriever walks in and lies down on the rug in front of the sofa.
Night falls outside the window.

scenes.title: Town square
scenes.initial_prompt: A town square with a stone fountain and an empty wooden bench, on a sunny afternoon.

prompts.prompt: A woman in a blue coat walks in and stands by the fountain.
Nothing else changes.
The person who just arrived sits down on the bench.
Nothing else happens.

scenes.title: Parking lot
scenes.initial_prompt: An empty parking lot in front of a small supermarket, in the daytime.

prompts.prompt: A white delivery van drives in and parks in front of the supermarket.
Nothing else changes.
A man loads several big cardboard boxes into the vehicle that just parked.
Nothing else happens.

scenes.title: Beach hut
scenes.initial_prompt: A sunny beach: a blue wooden beach hut, a striped deck chair standing on the sand, and a calm sea.

prompts.prompt: A black labrador runs in and lies down next to the deck chair.
The sky turns stormy and grey.

scenes.title: Waterfall
scenes.initial_prompt: A waterfall pouring into a clear pool on a sunny day, with mossy rocks and a fallen tree trunk at the edge.

prompts.prompt: A rainbow appears over the waterfall.
A brown bear wades into the pool and stands in the water.
